svg.aria-label: Otto on a Mac: hold Control Option Space and ask it to reply to Jordan, it transcribes on your Mac, checks Gmail in the background, waits for you to allow the send, then shows the result.

g.text: Hold ⌃ ⌥ Space and say what you need
Let go. It's transcribed on your Mac
Otto works on it in the background
Anything that sends or changes waits for you
The result lands when it's done
• Move the launch review to Thursday
• Send the hiring plan to the team by Friday
"Reply to Jordan that Friday at 3 works"
Friday at 3 works. See you then!
